final: SELECT CASE a.frequency WHEN 'POPLATEK MESICNE' THEN 'monthly' WHEN 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN 'weekly' WHEN 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' THEN 'after each transaction' END AS statement_frequency, CASE o.k_symbol WHEN 'POJISTNE' THEN 'insurance' WHEN 'SIPO' THEN 'household payment' WHEN 'LEASING' THEN 'leasing' WHEN 'UVER' THEN 'loan payment' END AS debit_purpose FROM account AS a JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND o.amount = 3539
